summary: Enhance your understanding of data privacy and security with our GDPR training course. Equip yourself with essential skills to navigate compliance effectively.
lede: Data privacy and security training helps privacy, security, IT audit, and compliance professionals protect personal data across organizational systems. It covers mapping data flows, assessing privacy risks, applying access controls and retention practices, managing data subject requests and third-party risks, and developing impact assessments and transparent privacy notices through practical exercises.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals tasked with safeguarding personal data and ensuring organizational alignment with international privacy standards.
modules: Data Subject Rights and Request Management
Third-Party Risk and Data Processing Agreements
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of information technology systems and general business operations. Prior exposure to data handling policies or basic security concepts is recommended but not required. No specific software is needed, though access to a spreadsheet application for exercises is beneficial.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
